models: No iconic dedicated guitar (Lake primarily known as bassist)
guitar.evidence: ELP had no dedicated guitarist; Greg Lake played some acoustic guitar but is primarily known as bassist/vocalist.

tone.target: sustaining lead with expressive vibrato and slight analog bloom
tone.profile: sustaining lead with expressive vibrato and slight analog bloom
tone.summary: A vintage-voiced signal chain using a mild OD boost into an AC30-style amp, paired with a Chorus alternative for subtle bloom, emphasizing clean headroom and lead tone sustain.

rig.name: Emerson, Lake & Palmer - Lucky Man - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and hum.
Provide gentle boost for lead lines and increase sustain.
blocks.gap: The 'sustain pedal' clue suggests a dedicated boost, which is best modeled by the general Boost module.

alternatives.reason: If more grit than just sustain is needed.

blocks.purpose: Keep the tone clean and focused on natural amp breakup.
blocks.gap: The 'mild breakup' is best achieved by relying on the chosen amplifier model (AC30 TB) rather than a dedicated distortion pedal, keeping the signal transparent.

alternatives.reason: If more pronounced grit is required.

blocks.purpose: Model the classic British Plexi/Marshall sound with natural breakup and chime.
blocks.gap: The AC30 TB is the closest model to the desired vintage British tone (Plexi/Marshall edge).

blocks.purpose: Provide a classic British cabinet voicing that complements the AC30 model.
Slightly scoop the low end and boost mids/highs to enhance lead clarity and 'singing' quality.
blocks.gap: Used for fine-tuning the tone, as no specific EQ was requested beyond general sustain enhancement.

blocks.purpose: Add subtle analog bloom and controlled vibrato effect without sounding like a modern chorus.
blocks.gap: The 'vibrato' requirement is met by the Chorus module, as dedicated vibrato units are absent. Settings are kept mild to avoid excessive modulation.

alternatives.reason: If a more rhythmic pitch wobble is desired instead of subtle bloom.

blocks.purpose: Add natural space and 'bloom' to the sustained notes.

improvements.summary: Upgrade IR to better capture the vintage British cabinet sound.

proposals.reason: Enhance classic Plexi/Marshall voicing and midrange punch.
